records.title: Circuit Complexity Bounds for RoPE-based Transformer Architecture
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.07602. The abstract establishes theoretical circuit-complexity bounds for RoPE Transformers; it does not propose or measure inference efficiency.

records.title: End-to-End Training for Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Self-Resampling
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.15702. Contribution is training for autoregressive video diffusion and exposure-bias reduction, not LLM inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: Division-of-Thoughts: Harnessing Hybrid Language Model Synergy for Efficient On-Device Agents
records.reason: Measured savings apply to a hybrid local-SLM/cloud-LLM agent workflow and task/API cost; transfer to standalone serving is uncertain.

records.title: LongAgent: Scaling Language Models to 128k Context through Multi-Agent Collaboration
records.reason: Multi-agent long-document retrieval results are tied to this context-processing setup; general LLM serving transfer is not established.

records.title: A Review of Hybrid and Ensemble in Deep Learning for Natural Language Processing
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.05589. Broad survey of NLP hybrid/ensemble models, not a paper-specific LLM inference optimization.
